ephemeral is Ethereum's private receive layer and a non-custodial trading terminal. Payments land on fresh one-time stealth addresses (ERC-5564 with the ERC-6538 registry) that only the receiver can find and spend. No new chain, no mixer pool, no bridge, and ephemeral never holds user keys or funds.

The terminal: perps via Hyperliquid, a Solana token feed and a multichain swap beta. You always sign in your own wallet.

EPH trades in one official pool: Uniswap v4 ETH/EPH with the ephemeral hook.
